name: You Can't Dodge Your Feelings!
source:
A young girl scared of the prospect of confessing to her crush resolves to finally do it after the big ball game... Will she succeed and find love? It's all up to you to help her!

[From [url=https://autumnotopia.itch.io/you-cant-dodge-your-feelings]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名年轻女孩害怕向自己暗恋的对象表白，最终决定在大型球赛结束后表白……她会成功并找到爱情吗？这一切都取决于你来帮助她！

[来自[url=https://autumnotopia.itch.io/you-cant-dodge-your-feelings]Itch.io[/url]]
